summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 10 for SUSE Linux Enterprise Micro 6.0)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-32.1 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-43284: xfrm: esp: avoid in-place decrypt on shared skb frags (bsc#1264459).
